#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Durable key-value records service.

GET /health        -> 200 "ready"
PUT /records/<id>  -> 204 (stores raw body)
GET /records/<id>  -> 200 (returns exact stored body)
"""
import os
import sys
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer

PORT = int(os.environ.get("BUILDER_APP_PORT", "8080"))
STORE_DIR = os.environ.get("BUILDER_APP_STORE", "/var/lib/builder-app/records")


def _record_path(record_id: str) -> str:
    # Reject empty or path-traversal ids; keep everything else verbatim.
    if not record_id or "/" in record_id or record_id in (".", ".."):
        return ""
    return os.path.join(STORE_DIR, record_id)


class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    server_version = "builder-app/1.0"
    protocol_version = "HTTP/1.1"

    def _send(self, code: int, body: bytes = b"", content_type: str = "application/octet-stream", extra_headers=None):
        self.send_response(code)
        if code != 204:
            self.send_header("Content-Type", content_type)
            self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
        else:
            self.send_header("Content-Length", "0")
        if extra_headers:
            for k, v in extra_headers.items():
                self.send_header(k, v)
        self.end_headers()
        if body and code != 204:
            try:
                self.wfile.write(body)
            except BrokenPipeError:
                pass

    def log_message(self, fmt, *args):
        sys.stderr.write("%s - %s\n" % (self.address_string(), fmt % args))

    def do_GET(self):
        path = self.path.split("?", 1)[0]
        if path == "/health":
            self._send(200, b"ready", "text/plain; charset=utf-8")
            return
        if path.startswith("/records/"):
            rid = path[len("/records/"):]
            fp = _record_path(rid)
            if not fp or not os.path.isfile(fp):
                self._send(404, b"not found", "text/plain; charset=utf-8")
                return
            with open(fp, "rb") as fh:
                body = fh.read()
            self._send(200, body)
            return
        self._send(404, b"not found", "text/plain; charset=utf-8")

    def do_PUT(self):
        path = self.path.split("?", 1)[0]
        if not path.startswith("/records/"):
            self._send(404, b"not found", "text/plain; charset=utf-8")
            return
        rid = path[len("/records/"):]
        fp = _record_path(rid)
        if not fp:
            self._send(400, b"invalid id", "text/plain; charset=utf-8")
            return
        length = int(self.headers.get("Content-Length", 0))
        body = self.rfile.read(length) if length > 0 else b""
        tmp = fp + ".tmp"
        with open(tmp, "wb") as fh:
            fh.write(body)
            fh.flush()
            os.fsync(fh.fileno())
        os.replace(tmp, fp)
        self._send(204)


def main() -> None:
    os.makedirs(STORE_DIR, exist_ok=True)
    httpd = ThreadingHTTPServer(("0.0.0.0", PORT), Handler)
    httpd.daemon_threads = True
    sys.stderr.write(f"builder-app listening on :{PORT}, store={STORE_DIR}\n")
    try:
        httpd.serve_forever()
    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        pass
    finally:
        httpd.server_close()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
